result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where metadata text overlaps under a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25-35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text labels overlap each other at the same position, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the horizontal layout or flex/stacking constraints for the restaurant metadata row so that the delivery time and delivery fee are separated with proper spacing or a delimiter.
